serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
You: Wait, wait, wait… {{wi}}this kind of broke my immersion right there!
What the hell are you talking about?!
'Nun' Shanice: W-what do you mean? Which part did you not understand?
You: All of it! There’s no way any of this happened!
'Nun' Shanice: Huh?! I wouldn’t lie about something like that! 
You: Oh really? What about the ‘I got a little hard’ part?
'Nun' Shanice: I-It’s not my fault he said it! He was actually a perverted old man!
You: Come on! The mech part is even more suspicious. Wouldn’t something like a GIANT ROBOT ERECTS FROM THE SAINT PETER’S BASILICA be on the news?
'Nun' Shanice: I don’t know! Stop asking hard questions! I-It was an international scandal so maybe they redacted it!
You: Yeah, yeah sure. It was nice hearing you Shanice. Call me later when you will be less high.
'Nun' Shanice: Wait! I was about to tell you the best part!…
You: Bye bye~
